title: SettlementReceipt (Vauban Pay spec v0.3 §4.3, Phase 2a target shape)
description: Phase 2a target shape for the SettlementReceipt Claim, mapping to fiscal_authority (issue #2405) seven-field qualification surface and to the charge_evidence reference value the metadata block points at. The SettlementReceipt is a VPSF Claim sextuplet (Subject, Predicate, Evidence, TemporalFrame, RevelationMask, Anchor). Canonical preimage discipline: JSON Canonicalization Scheme (JCS) per RFC 8785, hashed with SHA-256 (lowercase hex), per x402-foundation/x402 issue #2326 v3 canonicalisation discipline section. The receipt_hash = SHA-256(JCS(receipt_object)) is the audit-time-re-verifiable digest a regulator pins for retention windows of 4-6 years (MiCA Art. 80, DORA Art. 14, AMLR Art. 56).

canon_version.description: Canonicalisation discipline revision per x402#2326 v3. Two accepted forms : (a) `x402-jcs-v1.0.0` (Phase 2a explicit prefix, recommended for new emitters), (b) `1.0` or `1.0.0` (compact form, backward-compatible with `stark-vauban-pay-v1` Axis 1 fixtures on PR #2413). Maps to fiscal_authority field 6 (audit/canonicalisation version).

subject.description: VPSF sextuplet element 1: who is the Claim about. For SettlementReceipt, the Subject is the merchant who received the payment.

kind.description: Subject kind. MerchantPseudonym = Poseidon(merchant_secret, app_domain, recipient_salt) per spec §2.3. Maps to fiscal_authority field 1 (provider/resource identity).

predicate.description: VPSF sextuplet element 2: what is asserted about the Subject. For SettlementReceipt, the Settlement predicate carries the verified charge.

amount.description: Amount in smallest indivisible unit of currency, u256 as decimal string (integer base units, no float). Maps to fiscal_authority field 2 (exact charge amount).

currency.description: Currency identifier URN (e.g. urn:eip3009:USDC:starknet-sepolia). Maps to fiscal_authority field 2 (asset + network).

nullifier.description: felt252 nullifier consumed from the originating PaymentIntent. Anti-double-spend primitive.

intent_ref.description: ClaimRef pointing to the originating PaymentIntent. Maps to fiscal_authority field 5 (receipt/charge_evidence reference, via parent intent linkage).

settlement_index.description: Monotonic index within the merchant settlement stream. Anti-replay + audit ordering primitive.

evidence.description: VPSF sextuplet element 3: proof that the Predicate holds. For SettlementReceipt, evidence is a VerifiedAttestation referencing the proven PaymentIntent + verifier signature.

intent_proof_ref.description: ClaimRef pointing to the STARK proof of the originating PaymentIntent (payment_circuit, spec §5.1).

verifier_pubkey.description: felt252 verifier public key (the verifier that signed off on the intent proof).

signature.description: SNIP-12 signature over the canonical Predicate preimage. Variable length depending on scheme.

batch_proof_ref.description: Optional ClaimRef to the aggregation circuit proof if this receipt is part of a batched settlement (spec §5.2 aggregation_circuit).

temporal_frame.description: VPSF sextuplet element 4: time validity. For SettlementReceipt, Instant marks the settlement moment (single point, not a window).

issued_at.description: Unix timestamp when the receipt was issued by the verifier.

revelation_mask.description: VPSF sextuplet element 5: per-field disclosure policy. Per spec §4.3 default mask: amount/currency/nullifier/merchant/intent_ref Open, payer_pseudonym Hidden (privacy preservation).

anchor.description: VPSF sextuplet element 6: on-chain commitment. For SettlementReceipt, StarknetSettlement records the on-chain settlement event.

chain_id.description: Starknet chain identifier as felt252 hex. Sepolia: 0x534e5f5345504f4c4941 (ASCII SN_SEPOLIA). Maps to fiscal_authority field 2 (network).

tx_hash.description: felt252 Starknet transaction hash of the settlement event.

event_index.description: Index of the PaymentReceiptEmitted event within the transaction.
